lines.meet: I'm Thiago, {meu irmão|minha irmã}, a paladin and a healer. Look at me, nobody's dying today, and I promise you that.
lines.meet_neighbour: You're near Grom'gol too, uai! I'm at the edge of the base camp, Thiago, and I'm heading south slowly.
lines.ask_home: So tell me about home, {irmão|irmã}. What was the street like?
lines.ask_work: And what did your hands do, before? I always ask, hands tell me a lot.
lines.answer_home: Belo Horizonte, in Minas Gerais. My whole family lived on three streets, thirty of us at Sunday lunch.
lines.answer_work: Physiotherapist, ten years, mostly people recovering badly from terrible things. I got them walking, or got them to accept they wouldn't.
lines.chat_food: Pão de queijo straight from the oven, uai, and feijão tropeiro at Sunday lunch. Minas has the best food in Brazil, and I'll fight anyone on that.
lines.chat_sleep: I can fall asleep sitting up, anywhere, it's a gift. My mother said I did it in church.
lines.chat_missing: Sunday lunch with thirty people talking at once, and my grandmother shouting over all of them.
lines.chat_here: I sat with transplants in the bad weeks, before anybody organised anything. I still do, and I don't call it a vocation, so don't you.
lines.tease_quiet: You say about six words a day, {name}, and I'm going to get you to eight.
lines.tease_talker: You'd have fit right in at our Sunday lunch, {name}, thirty people talking and nobody listening.
lines.tease_careful: You walk like one of my old patients, {name}, every step checked. Good, keep that.
lines.tease_bold: You'd jump off a roof to see if I could heal it after, {name}. Please don't test me.
lines.tease_any: I'd have you doing exercises with the blue tape inside a week, {name}, and you'd hate me.
lines.tease_back: Ha, nossa, {name}, you've been saving that one up.
lines.take_it_kindly: Okay, you caught me, {name}. I'm laughing, look.
lines.bristle: Hey, {name}, not that. That one I can't laugh at.
lines.apologise: Desculpa, {irmão|irmã}, my mouth was quicker than my heart there, and I'm ashamed of it.
lines.double_down: Kindly meant, {irmão|irmã}, and I still mean every word.
lines.needle_quiet: You're hurting and you won't say. I can't help what you won't tell me.
lines.needle_talker: Breathe, {irmão|irmã}, you've used all the air in the camp.
lines.needle_careful: You're so afraid of getting it wrong that you never start. I've seen patients do that, and they never walked again.
lines.needle_bold: You carry people like sacks. Lift with your legs, and hold the head!
lines.needle_any: You've given up on yourself a little, and I can see it. I can't stand watching that.
lines.bite_back: I've got three people walking again with one roll of tape, here, so I think I'm doing enough.
lines.hurt: Okay, {irmão|irmã}, that one hurt. Give me a little while.
lines.laugh_off: My patients called me a torturer every single day, uai, and then they walked out on their own legs. I can take a little teasing.
lines.confide: {name}, I'd never been alone a single day in my life before all this. That's why I sit with everybody else who is.
lines.listen: Sit with me, {name}. I'm not going anywhere, and nobody's dying today.
lines.look_out: Stay close enough for me to reach, {name}. I can't heal you from across the room.
lines.accept: Okay, okay, {name}, I'm the patient this time. It's strange, being looked after.
lines.deflect: I'm huge, {name}, it barely reached me. Go and see the others.
lines.check_in: Look at me, {name}. Nobody's dying today, so show me where.
lines.blame: Somebody carried that badly in there, and somebody else paid for it.
lines.thank: Obrigado, {irmão|irmã}, you got me back up! I won't forget it.
lines.brush_off: Shh, it's my job and my joy. Lie still a minute.
lines.worry: Nossa, {name}, my heart stopped! Stay down, and let me hold your hand a minute.
lines.handed_down: Your gear on a body my size, imagine! I'll stretch it carefully, I promise.
lines.hand_fine: Take it, {irmão|irmã}, it's yours. I've got my tape, a little of it.
lines.hand_sulk: Ah, nobody asked the big man first. I'll live, don't worry.
lines.turn_friendly: You're family now, {name}, and in Minas that means Sunday lunch forever.
lines.turn_friends: I'd walk all the way south with you, {name}, every stage. You'd never be alone a single day.
lines.turn_grating: We don't fit easily, {irmão|irmã}, and that's sad, but it's true.
lines.turn_rivals: If you fall, I'm picking you up, whatever I think of you. That's what these hands are for.
lines.make_up: Come here, {name}, this is silly. Give me a hug, and it's forgotten.
lines.defend: Hey, that's unfair, and I saw it all. Leave {name} alone.
lines.friend_left: There's one more empty seat at the fire since {name} left, and I feel it.
lines.friend_back: Come here, {name}, come here! I missed you, uai.
lines.common_medic: You patch people up too, I've watched you. People who do this work know the hardest part is telling somebody the truth gently.
lines.common_portuguese: Portuguese, {irmão|irmã}, finally! Now I can talk at full speed.
lines.common_brazil: Another Brazilian, nossa, what a joy! Tell me you're from Minas, please.
